items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Now, that's where I like to, I try to play sweet on account of him.

ctx.x: Right! Charlie Spivak. You're right. He was living out in Greensboro, South Carolina. Every December I used to drive through there. I couldn't get in touch with him. He was playing at a restaurant there. He owned part of it. But, I could never get by there to see him. I knew him through those years too. But he, I understand he retired just maybe about a year ago, just stopped ~~this~~ just about a year now. Now, that's where I like to, I try to play sweet on account of him.
